<Preview>
  <goa-modal heading="Confirm record deletion" open="true">
    Are you sure that you want to delete this record?
    <goa-button-group alignment="end" slot="actions">
      <goa-button type="secondary">Cancel</goa-button>
      <goa-button type="tertiary" variant="destructive">Delete record</goa-button>
    </goa-button-group>
  </goa-modal>
</Preview>
description: Use a destructive button to indicate the final destructive action.
